name: Aura Identity Protection

price.headline: From $12 per month (individual)
price.note: Family plans available from $37/month. Annual billing is cheaper.

pros: $1 million insurance per adult on family plans
VPN and password manager included at no extra cost
cons: Higher monthly price than basic credit monitoring
VPN has data limits on the lower tier
best_for: families who want one service covering everyone
people who have had identity theft before
skip_if: you only want basic credit monitoring; free services from your bank may be enough
rating_reason: One of the most complete identity protection services we cover. The $1 million insurance and three-bureau monitoring stand out. The price is higher but justified for families.
